source: Owner answers to four multiple-choice questions asked in the planning session of 2026-11-16, followed by owner approval of the plan (research/production_loop_20261116/PLAN_KO.md). The selected option labels are quoted verbatim.

decisions.meaning: Merge on a separate integration branch; adopt only if the 1.94.1 build, the full tests and bitwise identity of the protected RODAS5P paths pass; otherwise port additive modules only. Ledger rows backed by simulation scripts get superseding INVALID rows; existing rows are kept.
decisions.gate_effect: Explicit conditional owner approval for the protected-blob changes that the merge brings (MUTATION_GATES immutable list), valid only if the stated conditions hold; the blob delta list is reported in the wave report.

decisions.meaning: One pre-registered decision experiment (sigma_max=1.5 stability with the independent oracle, per-step cost at equal implementation maturity, large-n regime with reference to the REI 46k run); freeze as opt-in comparator if the criteria fail.

Registry-based single entry point, explicit method choice, opt-in Auto policy and typed fallback with charged work and preserved prefix. Default routing and protected RODAS5P unchanged; promotion is a separate decision.
G0 stays unchanged. A separate release-readiness gate (R-gate) for the scoped package with protected RODAS5P as default is defined and judged per axis.

decisions.topic: adoption of the trial merge of 93392249 although the frozen rule is formally not met
decisions.asked_after: wave 1 gates: T1 PASS, T5 PASS, T2 1210 passed / 2 failed (source-pinning sentinels g3, h2), T3 strict FAIL by 600 added serde keys with 0 changed values, T6 FAIL
decisions.meaning: Adopt the merge on the loop branch. Re-pin sentinels g3 and h2 to the post-merge bytes with a record of old and new pins; regenerate the one golden file whose only difference is added keys; add INVALID superseding rows for L-0209..L-0214; the unified router defects are handled in V03 (real dispatch or removal); hook settings are not edited, only reported.

decisions.topic: declaration of loop modules in rodas5p-integrators/src/lib.rs
decisions.meaning: The owner allowlist of sentinel g3 is extended: besides `pub mod ppsw1;` the file may hold the loop L1 module lines; the allowed lines are named in the test.
Open a draft pull request from the loop branch to research/production-unification-20261115, titled as not a release, never merged by the agent, to run production.yml.

decisions.topic: evidence branches v15 and trial whose push was denied by the permission classifier
decisions.meaning: The owner pushes research/production-loop-20261116-v15 and -trial manually; the agent does not retry.

plan_approval.includes: commit and standalone push of research branches of this loop after each wave

not_authorized: change of G0, tolerances or protected RODAS5P controller constants
